start_here: HOW TO READ THIS CANVAS. Five sections top to bottom, each on its own coloured board with its title: 1 Production (on prod today), 2 Design final not on prod, 3 In discussion, 4 Rejected, 5 Mistakes fixed. Inside Section 1 the rows follow the customer's journey left to right (first open and address, menu to order, after the order, You and alerts and feedback, no connection and Night), then kitchen, rider, admin. Every board's name starts with its state: LIVE, ON STAGING (coded, flag off on prod), DESIGN (approved, not coded), IN TALK, REJECTED, OLD (the wrong version; its fix is named in the section note), UNSORTED (not placed yet). Green notes are story notes next to the boards they describe. The layout is generated from design/canvas-stages.json by canvas_stage.py; a board moves by editing that file, never by dragging.
